purpose: Redesign the existing Nexlearn hero section using the Finora reference's airy fintech visual language while retaining Nexlearn's brand identity, ERPNext messaging, dashboard concept, navigation, and conversion actions.

design_direction.reference_influence: Finora hero: soft mint gradient, generous whitespace, crisp typography, white floating cards, subtle shadows, compact pill navigation, and layered product UI.

brand_preservation.logo: Keep the existing circular N logo and wordmark.

avoid: Do not copy Finora's finance-specific content or currency UI.
Do not remove ERPNext workflow details.
Do not turn the hero into a generic SaaS landing page.
Do not use excessive glass blur that reduces readability.
Do not replace the Nexlearn logo or blue brand accent.

logo.asset: Use the existing Nexlearn logo asset

appearance.container: white translucent pill with subtle border and soft shadow
appearance.active_item: blue accent or very light blue surface

header.responsive: On mobile, retain the logo and show a compact menu trigger; keep WhatsApp and Enquire accessible without overflowing.

headline.text: Learn ERPNext the way businesses run it.
headline.style: large bold modern sans-serif, tight line-height, responsive sizing

left_column.description: Two 3-month online programmes: one for future functional consultants, one for Frappe developers. Live classes, real business scenarios and a final project that takes a complete ERPNext setup from requirements to reports.

main_card.title: Sample Document Flow
main_card.subtitle: SELL → DELIVER → BILL → COLLECT
main_card.style: large white or very pale blue card, rounded corners, subtle border and soft shadow
main_card.workflow_visual: Vertical connected timeline with blue nodes, thin connector line, compact reference IDs, right-aligned values and small status chips.

floating_dashboard.description: A smaller ERP analytics dashboard floating above and slightly behind the workflow card.
elements: Revenue or business performance line chart
floating_dashboard.style: white surface with restrained blue accents and minimal shadows

floating_notifications.label: Invoice paid
floating_notifications.caption: ACC-SINV-00031
floating_notifications.style: small white notification card with green confirmation icon

feature_strip.appearance: Four clean white cards with thin cool-gray borders, gentle shadows, rounded corners, dark headings and muted supporting text.

effects: very subtle mint glow behind the dashboard
faint abstract curved shapes or soft radial gradients

typography.font_family: Inter, Manrope, or existing website font
typography.eyebrow: monospace or compact uppercase sans-serif with letter spacing

surfaces.cards: white with subtle cool-gray border and soft diffuse shadow
surfaces.buttons: rounded pill or softly rounded rectangle
surfaces.glass_effect: use sparingly for small floating UI only; keep all text high contrast

visual_style.spacing: airy, generous spacing similar to the Finora reference

responsive_rules.desktop: Keep the two-column composition. Align the text vertically around the center of the dashboard. Let the dashboard cards overlap subtly.
responsive_rules.tablet: Reduce headline size and dashboard scale; preserve clear separation between text and visual.
responsive_rules.mobile: Stack text first, CTAs second, dashboard visual third, and feature cards in a two-column or single-column grid. Remove decorative overlap if it causes clipping. Collapse navigation.

interaction_and_accessibility.animations: Use restrained fade/float transitions only; avoid distracting continuous movement.

implementation_constraints: Use the current Nexlearn website codebase and existing assets; do not rebuild unrelated sections.
Change only the hero section and its directly associated header styling if necessary.
Preserve all existing destinations, WhatsApp URL, enquiry behaviour and programme anchors. Do not invent replacement URLs.
Build the dashboard, workflow timeline, metric tiles and notifications as real HTML/CSS components, not as a flattened screenshot.
Keep all provided programme copy and workflow labels unchanged unless a correction is explicitly requested.
The existing screenshot is the source of truth for Nexlearn content; the Finora screenshot is only a visual reference.
Check desktop and mobile layouts and prevent horizontal overflow.
If a current logo or dashboard asset exists, reuse it rather than recreating it.
acceptance_criteria: The result visibly adopts the lighter, airy, mint-tinted visual language of the Finora reference.
Nexlearn remains recognizable through its logo, blue accent color, wording and ERPNext workflow.
The hero remains conversion-focused with Choose your track and Enquire now actions.
The document workflow remains readable and visually prominent.
The four programme information cards remain present.
The header remains compact and usable at desktop and mobile widths.
